longest_story.synopsis: Mesmero offers Spider-Man $400 a week if he will agree to make special appearances in his Broadway show. Unfortunately, the drama critic for the Globe hates Mesmero's performance and pans him in the newspaper. Mesmero hypnotizes the unkind reviewer and compels him to wrap himself in chains and jump off the Brooklyn Bridge. Spider-Man intervenes, which Mesmero sees as tantamount to betrayal. When Spider-Man shows up for his curtain call, Mesmero tries to kill him in front of a captive audience.

longest_story.synopsis: A mysterious figure (later to be revealed as Llyra) breaks the Wizard out of Ryker's Island prison so they can get revenge on both Spider-Man and the Sub-Mariner respectively. The Wizard sends a giant gold robot spider to climb up the World Trade Center to goad Spider-Man into a fight so he can steal his spider-sense energy. Spider-Man knocks the robot off the side of the building destroying it, but the Wizard is able to get the energy signature. He traces the energy to Peter Parker's apartment and sets it on fire. Spider-Man is able to rescue the neighbours but gets trapped saving a wino.

longest_story.synopsis: Both Spider-Man and the Black Cat have conflicting emotions about their new status as lovers. Spider-Man wants the Black Cat to go straight, even going so far as to ask Captain Jean DeWolff to get her a pardon. The Black Cat, on the other hand, has a hard time kicking old habits and wants the two of them to use their abilities to become thieves. Spider-Man tries to immobilize the Black Cat with his web, but rather than ending up in prison, she jumps in the river. Believing her dead, Spider-Man is even more sad to receive the news of a full pardon for the Black Cat.

longest_story.synopsis: Peter attends a party at Harry's place. Harry gets a delivery and runs off after opening it. Peter tracks him down and discovers that Harry is being blackmailed by the Hobgoblin. Peter goes with Harry to the blackmail meeting where he discovers Kingpin. There is a whole room of prominent businessmen who are being squeezed by Hobgoblin, including J. Jonah Jameson. Hobgoblin arrives to make his demands and is confronted by Spider-Man. Spider-Man is hit by a new and improved goblin gas that knocks him down and robs him of his spider sense. The Kingpin steps in to lend a hand.

longest_story.title: Confessions!
longest_story.first_line: He's been blasted, gassed, and beaten by the mysterious Hobgoblin.
longest_story.characters: Hobgoblin [Roderick Kingsley]; J. Jonah Jameson; Kingpin [Wilson Fisk]; Mamie Muggins; Harry Osborn; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; George Vandergill (villain); Stephanie
longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man has been robbed of his spider sense and rescued by the Kingpin. With Harry and Jonah still under the threat of blackmail by the Hobgoblin, Spider-Man contacts all of the businessmen who are being squeezed as he tries to get a line on who and where Hobgoblin is. Peter finally decides to use his old mechanical spider tracer receiver and is able to find the Hobgoblin's location. Spider-Man battles Hobgoblin it tough. Norman Osborn's Goblin journals are burned up and Hobgoblin is furious and blows up the building.
